consequence.statement: More query result types (stats, volume, label, series) are cached by default into the results_cache, in memory unless configured otherwise.

assertion.statement: Caching of TSDB 'stats', 'volume', 'label' and 'series' query results is now enabled by default, using the results_cache in the query_range config section (in-memory by default).
